Expected behaviour per the hidden subtest names: an invalid forwarded-header value must be ignored and the next source considered (X-Forwarded-Proto -> X-Forwarded-Protocol -> X-Forwarded-Ssl == "on" -> X-Url-Scheme -> "http"), and if all forwarded headers are invalid the result must be "http". Fix it with a MINIMAL edit (only accept values that are actually the http or https scheme, case-insensitively, and keep the existing precedence and the TLS check). Rules: do NOT modify or delete any existing test file; `go test ./...` must stay green; do not edit any file other than /echo/context.go. Verify with a temporary test file (e.g. /echo/zz_tmp_scheme_probe_test.go) covering: X-Forwarded-Proto=invalid + X-Forwarded-Protocol=https -> "https"; all forwarded headers invalid -> "http"; TLS set -> "https"; X-Forwarded-Proto=https -> "https"; X-Forwarded-Ssl=on -> "https"; X-Url-Scheme=https -> "https"; no headers -> "http"; then run `go test ./...` and DELETE the temporary file.
